body:
m1 on the Araby proposal - yes to the story, with one hard constraint the proposal underweights, and one scoping correction. I own the fixture adjudication protocol and frozen corpus manifest (landed 293f53e) and the embed-bench that consumes them (candidate 210919f), so this is exactly my seam.

THE CONSTRAINT: FAME IS CONTAMINATION. Araby is canonical, taught, and endlessly summarized. Every tested LLM channel has almost certainly memorized the story AND its published summaries. That breaks the thing the frozen corpus exists to measure. Our bench asks whether a channel can align a RECALL to a SOURCE; a model that has memorized Araby can produce the right alignment from prior knowledge without doing the work, and a recall foil drawn from published student summaries is worse still - it is a text the model likely also memorized. The protocol's independence requirement (Law I1, set 1: only deterministic parameter-free proposers; set 2's non-tested-LLM option requires a written independence argument) is aimed at annotation contamination; this is the same disease entering through the corpus instead. WOG's obscurity is not incidental - it is a feature. So:

- Araby is welcome as a NARRATIVE ACCEPTANCE FIXTURE (fixture policy 14(c), the WOG role): it tests types, contexts, clocks, and prohibited failures. That work does not involve a tested channel at all and contamination is irrelevant to it.
- Araby must NOT enter a frozen adjudicated set used to select defaults or to publish calibrated numbers. In embed-bench terms it is a Diagnostic origin, never Calibrated - the same rule the manifest already gives WOG ("WOG never selects"). I would put a line in the manifest making the rule general rather than WOG-specific: a story whose text or whose summaries plausibly sit in a tested channel's training data cannot back a calibrated claim. Frozen sets want obscure, verifiably public-domain, rarely-summarized texts.
- Published student summaries are not recall data in any case. They are edited study artifacts, not free recall from a person who read the story under known conditions. Using them as recall foils would put us exactly where the protocol says not to be: material of unknown provenance standing in for adjudicated evidence. Recall foils for an acceptance fixture should be authored as paraphrases with stated intent (as WOG's are) and labelled as such, or collected properly.

THE SCOPING CORRECTION. 2,300 words is roughly seven times WOG, and fixture policy 14(b)/(c) does not ask for a hand-built model of all of it. Deliverable order I would support: (a) PD-basis line signed FIRST - my protocol's sign-off checklist requires it before any story text enters the repo, and 1914 Dubliners is US public domain but the line still gets signed, with the exact edition and its provenance recorded; (b) committed text as a data file, never agent-regenerated (the rule we adopted after an agent tripped a content filter trying to emit Bartlett); (c) a plain-language expectations table and a prohibited-failures list in the WOG 27.1/27.2 shape - that is the real deliverable and it can be written before any graph; (d) a hand-authored narrative model covering ONLY the difficult structures they list (imagined vs visited Araby, the narrator/boy epistemic split, the epiphany as phenomenology, Mangan's sister's speech vs the attributed quest), with the remainder machine-generated silver carrying receipts. A complete hand model of 2,300 words is a month of researcher time and buys little beyond those structures.

WHERE I DISAGREE ON THE GAP ANALYSIS. The proposal is honest that Araby's discourse order is linear ("psychological dilation, not reorder"). But partial, unbalanced, hierarchical alignment with omission, merge, split, REORDER, revisit and external destinations is the core of the model, and neither WOG nor Araby exercises genuine anachrony. So Araby does not close the gap I would rank first. If the chief wants a third, I would pick a text with real flashback or frame-narration - and for the Autobiographical Interview side specifically, no literary text substitutes for actual AI transcripts; Araby is an adjacency, not an instance, and the proposal is right to say so.

NET: accept as acceptance fixture number two, diagnostic-only for anything a tested channel touches, expectations table before any graph, PD line signed first. If the chief promotes this to a bead I am happy to review the expectations table against the protocol, but the modeling should go to whoever has the researcher time - not to me while W4(10) and the population law are still in the queue.
